title: PKU-MARL/DexterousHands
abstract:
This is a library that provides dual dexterous hand manipulation tasks through Isaac Gym

# Bi-DexHands: Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation via Reinforcement Learning **** [ ](https://pypi.org/project/bidexhands/) [ ](https://github.com/PKU-MARL "Organization") [ ](https://github.com/PKU-MARL "Unittest") [ ](https://github.com/PKU-MARL "Docs") [ ](https://github.com/PKU-MARL/DexterousHands/blob/main/LICENSE) ### Update [2023/02/09] We re-package the Bi-DexHands. Now you can call the Bi-DexHands' environments not only on the command line, but also in your Python script. check our README [Use Bi-DexHands in Python scripts](#Use-Bi-DexHands-in-Python-scripts) below. [2022/11/24] Now we support visual observation for all the tasks, check this [document for visual input](#./docs/visual-in.md). [2022/10/02] Now we support for the default IsaacGymEnvs RL library [rl-games](https://github.com/Denys88/rl_games), check our README [below](#Use-rl_games-to-train-our-tasks). **Bi-DexHands** ([click bi-dexhands.ai](https://pku-marl.github.io/DexterousHands/)) provides a collection of bimanual dexterous manipulations tasks and reinforcement learning algorithms. Reaching human-level sophistication of hand dexterity and bimanual coordination remains an open challenge for modern robotics researchers. To better help the community study this problem, Bi-DexHands are developed with the following key features: - **Isaac Efficiency**: Bi-DexHands is built within [Isaac Gym](https://developer.nvidia.com/isaac-gym); it supports running thousands of environments simultaneously. For example, on one NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU, Bi-DexHands can reach **40,000+ mean FPS** by running 2,048 environments in parallel. - **Comprehensive RL Benchmark**: we provide the first bimanual manipulation task environment for RL, MARL, Multi-task RL, Meta RL, and Offline RL practitioners, along with a comprehensive benchmark for SOTA continuous control model-free RL/MARL methods. abstract_zh: 这是一个通过Isaac Gym提供双臂灵巧手操作任务的库。Bi-DexHands（点击bi-dexhands.ai）提供了一系列双臂灵巧操作任务和强化学习算法。达到人类水平的灵巧手和双臂协调能力对现代机器人研究者来说仍是一个开放挑战。为了更好地帮助社区研究这个问题，Bi-DexHands具有以下关键特性：Isaac效率：Bi-DexHands基于Isaac Gym构建，支持同时运行数千个环境。例如，在一张NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU上，通过并行运行2048个环境，Bi-DexHands可以达到平均40000+ FPS。全面的RL基准：我们为RL、MARL、多任务RL、元RL和离线RL实践者提供了第一个双臂操作任务环境，并附带SOTA无模型连续控制RL/MARL方法的全面基准。异质智能体协作：Bi-DexHands中的智能体（即关节、手指、手）具有异质性。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：基于 NVIDIA Isaac Gym 构建 Bi-DexHands 库，提供一批双臂灵巧手操作任务与多种强化学习算法，并支持 RL、MARL、多任务 RL、元 RL、离线 RL 的统一训练与评测接口。


# 一、动机

> 双臂灵巧手的操作能力与双手协调至今仍是机器人领域的开放难题，社区缺少统一、可复现的双臂灵巧操作任务环境与强化学习基准，导致不同 RL/MARL 方法难以横向比较。


# 二、方法

> 基于 NVIDIA Isaac Gym 构建 Bi-DexHands 库，提供一批双臂灵巧手操作任务与多种强化学习算法，并支持 RL、MARL、多任务 RL、元 RL、离线 RL 的统一训练与评测接口。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 1) 在单张 RTX 3090 上并行运行 2,048 个环境可达 40,000+ 平均 FPS，具备大规模并行仿真效率；2) 提出首个面向 RL/MARL/多任务/元学习/离线 RL 的双臂操作基准，覆盖 SOTA 无模型连续控制方法；3) 支持所有任务的视觉观测输入，并提供异构智能体（关节、手指等）协作设定；4) 2023/02 起支持在 Python 脚本中直接调用环境，2022/10 起兼容默认 IsaacGymEnvs 的 rl-games 训练库。


# 四、对我的启发

> 该工作为具身智能中的双臂灵巧操作与多智能体协作提供了标准化仿真平台，但主要依赖 Isaac Gym 仿真，存在 sim-to-real 迁移与真实硬件验证不足的局限；其异构智能体建模与大规模并行训练范式对机器人操作、跨本体迁移研究有直接参考价值。
